cards.title: Money is a swap tool
cards.body: Money lets you swap without trading your toys for snacks. You earn it, then choose: spend some, save some, share some.

interaction.prompt: You earn L$10. Which plan saves something?
options: Spend L$6, save L$3, share L$1
interaction.explain: Saving a little every time adds up. Spending everything leaves nothing for later.

cards.title: More pieces, less each
cards.body: When there is more of something, each piece is worth less. Slide to cut the same L$12 pizza into more slices.

cards.title: Rare and wanted
cards.body: Things that are rare and wanted usually cost more. A rare sticker that nobody wants is still cheap.

interaction.prompt: Tap to see how VAULT stays rare
interaction.reveal: Only 21 million VAULT can ever exist. Nobody can print more, so it stays scarce.

cards.title: Waiting can pay
cards.body: Saving means choosing later over now. Small amounts can grow into something bigger.

options.label: Save 4 weeks
options.result: L$5 a week for 4 weeks is L$20 for something bigger.

quiz.prompt: A game suddenly makes many more gold coins. What happens to the value of each coin?
quiz.explain: More coins for the same things means each coin buys less.

cards.title: Buyers and sellers
cards.body: Prices move when buyers and sellers push against each other. More eager buyers lift the price. More eager sellers drop it.

options.label: More buyers
options.result: ↑ The price rises until enough people want to sell.

options.label: More sellers
options.result: ↓ The price falls until enough people want to buy.

cards.title: All eggs in one basket
cards.body: If most of your money sits in one coin, one bad day can hurt a lot. Slide to see what a 50% drop would cost you.

interaction.label: Share of your L$1,000 in one coin

cards.title: The hype cycle
cards.body: Hype is when people buy because everyone else is buying. Prices can rocket, then crash when new buyers run out.

interaction.prompt: Tap to see the usual shape of hype
interaction.reveal: A slow rise, a sudden spike, then a long slide as early buyers sell to late ones.

cards.title: Unlocks add coins
cards.body: Some coins are locked for the team at first. When they unlock, more coins can be sold.

interaction.prompt: Lots of team coins unlock next week. What could happen?
options: More coins for sale, so the price may fall
interaction.explain: Unlocks raise the number of coins that can be sold. That can mean sell pressure.

quiz.prompt: Why keep part of your money in L$ or PEG?
options: So one crash can't wipe you out
quiz.explain: A safe slice means a bad day hurts less, and you still have cash to use later.

cards.title: How a pool sets the price
cards.body: A pool holds L$ and a coin. Price is the L$ in the pool divided by the coins in it. The pool keeps x · y = k, so every buy lifts the price.

interaction.prompt: Tap to see what one big buy does
interaction.reveal: It adds L$ and removes coins, so the price jumps. That jump is called price impact.

cards.title: Who holds the liquidity?
cards.body: The creator often provides a coin's first liquidity. If it is not locked, they can take it back at any moment.

options.label: LP locked
options.result: The pool stays for the whole lock period. Holders can always sell.

options.label: LP unlocked
options.result: The creator can pull the pool. The price can crash to almost zero.

cards.title: Who owns the coins?
cards.body: Check the allocation. If insiders hold a big share, they can sell into everyone else.

cards.title: Fake volume
cards.body: Volume is how much was traded. Bots can trade with themselves to make a coin look popular.

interaction.prompt: Volume is huge, the price is flat and the same wallets trade back and forth. What is it?
interaction.explain: Wash trading inflates volume without real demand. Always ask who is really buying.

quiz.prompt: Which is the biggest red flag in a new coin?
options: The coin has a fixed supply
The creator can remove all the liquidity
Team coins unlock slowly over two years
quiz.explain: Unlocked liquidity lets the creator pull the pool. That is how a rug pull works.
